headline: Naperol Investments Ltd (BSE:500298, group X) is a Wadia Group holding-company shell born from a 2023 demerger of National Peroxide Ltd: the 1954-incorporated chemicals maker split its peroxygen-chemicals business into NPL Chemicals Ltd and kept the investments/leasing business plus the National Peroxide corporate shell, which was renamed Naperol Investments Ltd (scheme effective 11-Sep-2023, appointed date 1-Apr-2022). Debt-free (borrowings Rs 0 Cr FY2026), trading at 0.40x book value with a market value of investments (Rs 888 Cr) more than double its own market cap (Rs 369-371 Cr) - the classic holding-company discount. ROE/ROCE are near-zero (~1%) because most of the balance sheet is a passive investment portfolio, not operating capital. Two of BSE's own live-data endpoints disagree with screener.in on ROE and P/B by roughly 2x (see source_conflicts) - a data-trust trap for any pipeline that trusts a single BSE field.

former_names.value: National Peroxide Ltd (renamed/reorganised into Naperol Investments Ltd via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, effective 11-Sep-2023, appointed date 1-Apr-2022)
former_names.note: Company's own About Us page, verbatim: 'The Wadia Group ... founded the Company in year 1954 as a specialty chemical production Company. Pursuant to the effectiveness of the Scheme on September 11, 2023, the chemical business of the Company was transferred and vested in NPL Chemicals Limited and Naperol Investments Limited was amalgamated with the Company, respectively, with effect from the Appointed Date i.e. April 1, 2022, resulting in the formation of distinct and separate entities. Currently, the main operations of the Company include Investment and Leasing business.' The scrip 500298 / ISIN INE585A01020 is the SURVIVING original National Peroxide Ltd listing, renamed to Naperol Investments Ltd - this is the entity whose reported financial history (FY2015-FY2022 sales of Rs 200-400 Cr from chemicals manufacturing) belongs to a DIFFERENT business than the current Rs 20-30 Cr/yr holding-company revenue. TRAP: screener.in's own 'About' summary text is stale/wrong - it still reads 'National Peroxide Ltd is engaged in Investment and Leasing business', conflating the pre-scheme legal name with the post-scheme business description.

business_description.value: a) Manufacturing, distribution and dealing of peroxygen chemicals; b) Making long term investments and corporate lending directly and/or through its wholly owned subsidiary. Company's own 'About' summary (post-scheme, on its IR site): 'the main operations of the Company include Investment and Leasing business.'
business_description.note: Screener's 'Key Points > Services Offered' text (sourced from a BSE corporate filing PDF) still names peroxygen chemicals as line of business (a) even though the actual chemicals manufacturing was demerged into NPL Chemicals Ltd in Sep-2023 and standalone Sales collapsed from Rs 232 Cr (FY2022) to Rs 2 Cr (FY2023) onward - i.e. the filing text was not refreshed to match the post-demerger reality.

incorporated.note: 'The Wadia Group ... founded the Company in year 1954 as a specialty chemical production Company' (as National Peroxide Ltd). The current legal-entity name (Naperol Investments Ltd) dates only to the Sep-2023 scheme; the listed CIN/company itself is 72 years old (72nd AGM held 16-Sep-2026).

This YoY figure is NOT representative of the underlying business, which is a passive-investment holding company whose 'revenue' is largely dividend/interest income on the Rs 888 Cr investment book and swings quarter to quarter (Jun-2026 quarter alone was Rs 9.45 Cr vs Rs 2.94 Cr a year earlier, +221% QoQ-YoY) - a single blended annual growth number hides that volatility.

consolidated_vs_standalone.note: Standalone is the current/authoritative view: screener's default company page (used for all figures above) is standalone, current through Q1 FY2027 (Jun-2026). Screener's CONSOLIDATED view (/company/500298/consolidated/) is stale and effectively frozen: its quarterly data stops at quarter ended 2023-06-30 and its annual data stops at FY2023 (year ended 2023-03-31), both pre-dating the Sep-2023 demerger scheme. This is consistent with the company's own text that its formerly-consolidated wholly-owned subsidiary ('the Transferor Company') was itself amalgamated into the surviving entity under the same scheme - i.e. there is no longer a subsidiary to consolidate, so standalone and (stale) consolidated should NOT be diffed against each other for any period after mid-2023.

Small (0.8%) difference, most likely a trailing-window definition mismatch (BSE's 'EPS' field is not documented as TTM specifically) rather than an error, but recorded exactly since both are candidate 'current EPS' values.

traps: Renamed entity, stale description text: the listed company (BSE 500298 / ISIN INE585A01020) is the SAME legal entity as the former National Peroxide Ltd (a 1954-incorporated chemicals maker), renamed Naperol Investments Ltd via a Sep-2023 demerger scheme. A pipeline that trusts screener.in's cached 'About' text verbatim ('National Peroxide Ltd is engaged in Investment and Leasing business') will show the WRONG company name next to the right business description, or conflate this entity with the actual current National Peroxide Ltd / NPL Chemicals Ltd (the demerged chemicals business, a separate listed entity) if it does any name-based lookup.

Pre/post-demerger financial discontinuity: standalone annual Sales collapse from Rs 232 Cr (FY2022, chemicals-era) to Rs 2 Cr (FY2023) to Rs 20-33 Cr (FY2025/26/TTM, holding-company-era) is a real structural break, not a data error or a business collapse - any YoY or multi-year trend/CAGR computed across FY2022 and FY2023 for this scrip is meaningless and must be flagged, not silently charted.

FY2023 Net Profit of Rs 375 Cr (vs Rs 5 Cr the year before and Rs 11 Cr since) is a one-off demerger/scheme accounting entry (e.g. revaluation or transfer gain), not operating profit - a naive 'profit growth' or 'profit CAGR' calculation spanning FY2023 will produce an absurd spike-then-crash that looks like fraud or a data bug but is a real, disclosed one-time event.

Consolidated financials on screener.in are FROZEN at FY2023 / quarter ended Jun-2023 (the pre-scheme wholly-owned subsidiary no longer exists to consolidate) while standalone is fully current - a pipeline that defaults to 'consolidated when available' for this scrip will silently serve 3-year-old numbers as if current.

Two BSE API endpoints for the same scrip (ComHeader vs ComHeaderNew) return materially different ROE/PB for the same day - a pipeline single-sourcing 'the BSE value' for these two fields without cross-checking screener would show a number roughly half of what every other aggregator shows, with no error or staleness flag.

Group-X, thin float: promoter holding has been unchanged at exactly 70.77% for 12 consecutive quarters and free-float is only ~29%; combined with BSE group-X status this makes single-print/thin-volume price moves (the 990/490 52-week range) more likely to be a few large trades than a liquid market consensus - any 'market cap' or valuation multiple built on last-traded-price should be read with that caveat for this name specifically.
